subject: Hosted API quick eval — compact 30min slot proposal
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@sagemarket.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T08:14:00Z
Subject: Quick eval request — Hosted API (self-serve signup)

Hey Logan,

We just signed up for the self-serve Hosted API trial and I wanted to see if we could book a short walkthrough this week. We're a small PLG team (SageMarket) and want to validate latency/cost tradeoffs for our search-ranking reranker. Ideal: a compact 30-minute session to run through the API, a couple of sample prompts, and where to find model/quantization recommendations.

Timezone: Dublin (IST). Our engineers are available 09:30–12:30 IST.

Also attaching a one-page outline of what we'll try (sagemarket-requirements.pdf). Can you also provision a short sandbox with sample data or point me to the quickstart?

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Product, SageMarket

-----

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@sagemarket.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick eval request — Hosted API (self-serve signup)

Hi Liam — great to meet you and welcome to Redwood!

Thanks for the summary and the requirements doc. Short answer: yes, we can run a compact 30-minute eval and provision a short-lived sandbox for you to exercise the Hosted API. A couple of logistics so we make the time useful:
- Can you confirm whether you want embeddings + reranker or just generative reranking?
- Any dataset size expectations (tokens per request / batch sizes)?

Proposed 30-minute slots in IST:
- Tue 2027-08-03 10:00–10:30 IST
- Wed 2027-08-04 11:00–11:30 IST

Soojin will own the quick technical walkthrough; Diego can help with sandbox provisioning and extra credits. I attached a calendar invite stub (demo-invite.ics).

If none of those work, reply with a preferred slot and we'll accommodate.

Cheers,
Logan
SDR, Redwood Inference

Attachment: demo-invite.ics (calendar invite stub)
-----

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@sagemarket.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T13:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick eval request — Hosted API (self-serve signup)

Hi Liam — happy to run the 30-minute compact walkthrough. Thanks for the requirements doc; I skimmed it and put together a short agenda so we can get straight to hands-on:

Agenda (30 min):
- 0–5m: intros + goals (you share success criteria)
- 5–20m: live Hosted API calls (generation + rerank example using your sample prompt)
- 20–28m: recommended config (batching, quantization profile, caching) and cost/latency expectations
- 28–30m: next steps (sandbox creds, trial credits, and follow-up eval tasks)

If that sounds good, pick one of these IST slots: 10:00–10:30 Tue 8/3 or 11:00–11:30 Wed 8/4. Here's a short booking link if you'd prefer to pick directly: https://cal.com/redwood/soojin-30min

I've attached a one-page agenda (30min-eval-agenda.pdf) and the invite stub Logan mentioned. If you expect to bring a backend engineer, let me know — we can extend to 45 minutes.

Thanks!
Soojin Lee
Product Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: 30min-eval-agenda.pdf, demo-invite.ics
-----

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@sagemarket.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, ops@sagemarket.com
Date: 2027-08-02T17:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick eval request — Hosted API (self-serve signup)

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Wed 8/4 11:00–11:30 IST works, but our backend lead asked to join and we'd prefer 45 minutes to cover a short data-pipeline question. Can we move to 11:00–11:45 IST on 8/4?

Also: yes, we'll want embeddings + reranker. Dataset size is modest (~500 docs per query, batching expected). That should help you prep. The requirements doc has a brief table under "Expected traffic".

If you can provision a sandbox with sample rate limits (or temporary API key) and a handful of sandbox credits, that will let us exercise the full flow during the call. I've attached the requirements again for reference.

Best,
Liam
Head of Product, SageMarket

-----

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@sagemarket.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-02T17:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick eval request — Hosted API (self-serve signup)

Liam — I can provision a short-lived sandbox key and add 25 sandbox credits. I'll send the key to you via secure link before the call and include a brief post-call guide on how we measure latency & cost for your reranker.

Soojin — wed 11:00–11:45 IST is fine to extend to 45 if that helps.

Thanks,
Diego
Onboarding Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: (sandbox-provisioning-note.txt) — will deliver secure key link before session.
